# solution.Solution { #optyx.solution.Solution }

```python
solution.Solution(
    status,
    objective_value=None,
    values=dict(),
    multipliers=None,
    iterations=None,
    message='',
    solve_time=None,
    mip_gap=None,
    best_bound=None,
    constraint_violation=None,
    feasibility_tolerance=None,
    _raw_x=None,
    _raw_layout_signature=None,
)
```

Result of solving an optimization problem.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name                  | Type                                                     | Description                                                                                         |
|-----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| status                | [SolverStatus](`optyx.solution.SolverStatus`)            | Solver termination status.                                                                          |
| objective_value       | [float](`float`) \| None                                 | Optimal objective function value (None if not solved).                                              |
| values                | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [float](`float`)\]         | Dictionary mapping variable names to optimal values.                                                |
| multipliers           | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [float](`float`)\] \| None | Lagrange multipliers for constraints (if available).                                                |
| iterations            | [int](`int`) \| None                                     | Number of solver iterations.                                                                        |
| message               | [str](`str`)                                             | Solver message or error description.                                                                |
| solve_time            | [float](`float`) \| None                                 | Time taken to solve (seconds).                                                                      |
| constraint_violation  | [float](`float`) \| None                                 | Maximum post-solve feasibility violation. ``None`` means feasibility was not checked.               |
| feasibility_tolerance | [float](`float`) \| None                                 | Base absolute tolerance used for the feasibility check. ``None`` means feasibility was not checked. |

## Example {.doc-section .doc-section-example}

>>> solution = problem.solve()
>>> if solution.is_optimal:
...     print(f"Optimal value: {solution.objective_value}")
...     print(f"x = {solution['x']}")

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [from_json](#optyx.solution.Solution.from_json) | Create solution from JSON string or file path. |
| [get](#optyx.solution.Solution.get) | Get the optimal value of a variable with a default. |
| [print_vars](#optyx.solution.Solution.print_vars) | Pretty-print variable values. |
| [to_dict](#optyx.solution.Solution.to_dict) | Convert solution to dictionary. |
| [to_json](#optyx.solution.Solution.to_json) | Convert solution to JSON string or save to file. |

### get { #optyx.solution.Solution.get }

```python
solution.Solution.get(var, default=None)
```

Get the optimal value of a variable with a default.

For scalar Variable: returns float.
For VectorVariable: returns 1D numpy array.
For MatrixVariable: returns 2D numpy array.
For VariableDict: returns a dictionary keyed by its logical keys.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Description                                                               | Default    |
|---------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| var     | [Variable](`optyx.core.expressions.Variable`) \| [VectorVariable](`optyx.core.vectors.VectorVariable`) \| [MatrixVariable](`optyx.core.matrices.MatrixVariable`) \| [VariableDict](`optyx.core.variable_dict.VariableDict`) \| [str](`str`) | Variable, VectorVariable, MatrixVariable, VariableDict, or variable name. | _required_ |
| default | [float](`float`) \| [NDArray](`numpy.typing.NDArray`)\[[np](`numpy`).[floating](`numpy.floating`)\] \| [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [float](`float`)\] \| None                                                                             | Value to return if variable not found.                                    | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                                                                                                            | Description                      |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------|
|        | [float](`float`) \| [NDArray](`numpy.typing.NDArray`)\[[np](`numpy`).[floating](`numpy.floating`)\] \| [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [float](`float`)\] \| None | The optimal value(s) or default. |
